mapper.select: select a.module_id, p.param_type, p.api_id, p.module_table_id, td.table_name, p.field_id, p.field_name as fieldName, p.field_comment as fieldComment, c.java_type as dataType, c.is_not_null as required, p.default_value, p.valid_rule from cfg_module_api_param p inner join cfg_module_api a on p.api_id = a.id left join cfg_module_table t on a.module_id = t.module_id and p.module_table_id = t.id left join cfg_table_definition td on td.id = t.table_id left join cfg_column_definition c on c.id = p.field_id and c.table_id = td.id where p.api_id = #{apiId} order by p.sort,module_table_id,p.field_id
select p.* from cfg_module_api_param p inner join cfg_module_api a on p.api_id = a.id where a.module_id = #{moduleId} and a.service_code = #{serviceCode}
mapper.delete: delete from cfg_module_api_param where api_id in (select id from cfg_module_api where module_id = #{moduleId})
